q_001.sql: SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSales FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 5
q_001.answer: The top 5 best-selling genres by total sales are Rock ($826.65), Latin ($382.14), Metal ($261.36), Alternative & Punk ($241.56), and TV Shows ($93.53).

q_002.sql: SELECT a.AlbumId, a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'
q_002.answer: AC/DC has two albums: "For Those About To Rock We Salute You" and "Let There Be Rock".

q_003.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';
q_003.answer: The customers from Brazil are Luís Gonçalves (luisg@embraer.com.br), Eduardo Martins (eduardo@woodstock.com.br), Alexandre Rocha (alero@uol.com.br), Roberto Almeida (roberto.almeida@riotur.gov.br), and Fernanda Ramos (fernadaramos4@uol.com.br).

q_004.sql: SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1
q_004.answer: The most popular media type is MPEG audio file, with 3,034 tracks.

q_005.sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 1
q_005.answer: Jane Peacock has the most customers assigned to her, with 21 customers.

q_006.sql: SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name
q_006.answer: The 18 playlists contain between 0 and 3,290 tracks each: Music has 3,290, 90’s Music has 1,477, TV Shows has 213, Classical has 75, Brazilian Music has 39, Heavy Metal Classic has 26, the three Classical 101 playlists have 25 each, Grunge has 15, Music Videos and On-The-Go 1 each have 1, and the Movies and Audiobooks playlists have 0.

q_007.sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2021'
q_007.answer: The total revenue generated in 2021 was $449.46.

q_008.sql: SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) AS AverageInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY AverageInvoiceTotal DESC
q_008.answer: Average invoice totals by billing country, from highest to lowest, are Chile at $6.66; Ireland and Hungary at $6.52 each; the Czech Republic at $6.45; Austria at $6.09; Finland at $5.95; the Netherlands at $5.80; India at $5.79; the USA at $5.75; Norway at $5.66; Germany at $5.59; France at $5.57; Sweden and Portugal at $5.52 each; Brazil at $5.43; Canada at $5.43; and Argentina, Australia, Belgium, Denmark, Italy, Poland, Spain, and the United Kingdom at $5.37 each.

q_009.sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpending, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC) AS SpendingRank FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC LIMIT 5
q_009.answer: The top 5 customers by total spending are Helena Holý ($49.62, 1st), Richard Cunningham ($47.62, 2nd), Luis Rojas ($46.62, 3rd), and Ladislav Kovács and Hugh O'Reilly (tied at $45.62, 4th).

q_010.sql: SELECT ar.Name AS ArtistName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) AS NumberOfGenres FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3
q_010.answer: Iron Maiden has tracks in 4 different genres.
